(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (marker #f)
                  (mr 0)
                  (mc 0)
                  (dummy (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                               (when
                                 (and (not marker) (!= (at g r c) 0) (!= (at g r c) 5))
                                 (set! marker (at g r c))
                                 (set! mr r)
                                 (set! mc c))))
                  (rp (remainder mr 2))
                  (cp (remainder mc 2)))
             (build-grid hh
                         ww
                         (r c)
                         (if (and
                               (= (remainder r 2) rp)
                               (= (remainder c 2) cp)
                               (zero? (at g r c)))
                             marker
                             (at g r c)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))
         (objs (objects g 0))
         (marker (first (filter (lambda (o) (!= (obj-color o) 5)) objs)))
         (mr (first (first (obj-cells marker))))
         (mc (second (first (obj-cells marker))))
         (color (obj-color marker))
         (gray (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 5)) objs))
         (hit (first (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g mr c) 5)) (range (+ mc 1) w))))
         (target (first (filter (lambda (o) (member (list mr hit) (obj-cells o))) gray)))
         (period (+ 1 (obj-size target))))
    (build-grid h w (r c) (if (and (= (remainder r period) (remainder mr period)) (= (remainder c period) (remainder mc period)) (zero? (at g r c))) color (at g r c))))))
